title: The cavern ceiling on CTRL: a season of the land and cavern layers managed together, once with the v5.8 cavern quota set to fifteen and once with no ceiling at all, two replicates each. Every 3,000 ticks the wild units are counted per layer through the tool's own predicate (invaders excluded), with the invader count, the citizen count and the quota status. Pass: the ceiling arm holds the cavern layer at or near fifteen and reopens it when the layer falls below, the free arm runs above it, neither arm produces an out-of-season cavern arrival, both forts live, and every save is byte-identical.
fork: Does the cavern ceiling actually bite and then release, or does it either do nothing or close the cavern layer for good.

predictions.expects: ceiling arm: cavern count rises to about fifteen and stops, entries close while over and reopen under, no cavern arrival out of season; free arm: cavern count runs to E21's 13-36 band

predictions.model: the ceiling is a one-way door
predictions.expects: cavern entries close once and never reopen; the cavern layer empties and stays empty
both arms indistinguishable — DF's waves are not gated by entry quantity on the cavern layer

kill_criterion: the ceiling arm holds at or near fifteen AND recovers after a fall, in 2 of 2, with the free arm measurably higher, ships the per-layer quota
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: ceiling_15
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; cfg.layers.land=true; cfg.layers.water=false; cfg.layers.cavern=true; local pool=sw.buildPool(cfg); local n,c=0,0; for _,e in ipairs(pool) do if e.inEmbark and sw.defaultAllow(e) then cfg.allow[e.key]=true; n=n+1; if e.layer~='land' then c=c+1 end end end; local a,f=sw.assignFromMatrix(cfg,pool); cfg.groups.enabled=true; cfg.groups.coupling=false; cfg.ecology.enabled=false; cfg.quota.cavern=15; sw.saveConfig(cfg); local act=sw.applyLive(cfg, df.global.cur_season); sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.enableSched(); print(('roster: land + cavern — %d allowed (%d cavern), %d assigned, %d thin, %d applied; groups on, coupling off, ecology off; cavern ceiling 15'):format(n,c,a,f,act))

local ok,sw=pcall(reqscript,'seasonal-wildlife'); local by; if ok and sw.WILD then by=sw.WILD.countByLayer() else by={land=0,water=0,cavern=0}; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if dfhack.units.isWildlife(u) and not dfhack.units.isDead(u) and not u.flags1.inactive then local r=u.animal.population; local L=(r.cave_id>=0) and 'cavern' or ((r.feature_idx>=0) and 'water' or 'land'); by[L]=by[L]+1 end end end; local inv=0; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do local o,v=pcall(function() return u.invasion_id end); if o and v and v>=0 then inv=inv+1 end end; local cz=0; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if dfhack.units.isCitizen(u) and not dfhack.units.isDead(u) then cz=cz+1 end end; local o2,q=pcall(dfhack.run_command_silent,'seasonal-wildlife','quota'); print(('t7 layers: land=%d water=%d cavern=%d invaders=%d citizens=%d season=%d day=%d | %s'):format(by.land,by.water,by.cavern,inv,cz,df.global.cur_season,math.floor(df.global.cur_year_tick/1200),((q or ''):gsub('\n',' | ')):sub(1,240)))
